note: Synthetic, hand-shaped Batch consolidation results in the JSON contract the consolidation instruction asks for: one result per session (app, window, hour), items anchored into the session's numbered lines. NOT model output. The deliberate mistakes in it are listed in docs/extract-eval.md (Batch replay) so the replay exercises every scorer and parse path. Every item also carries `line` (the [n] number of its supporting line); the first commitment of the Oren Vale mail deliberately names the wrong line (2 instead of 3) so the anchor check rejects the number and the unique anchor still attributes it (AnchorStats::line_mismatch = 1).
